def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [List.map]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.map, ih]
      simp [myLen]

def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [← ih]
      simp

def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.map]
      rw [← ih, myLen]
      rfl

def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.map]
      simp [myLen] at *
      rw [ih]
      rfl
